datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule throughout 2019 for Malawi, classifying geographic areas into food insecurity phases based on standardized IPC methodology. The resulting spatial datasets represent near-term projections of acute food insecurity conditions across administrative and sub-administrative units.
